environment.source_status_note: Only architecture documentation is modified; all runtime code is committed.

sanitizers.leak_detection: Session ownership/arena unit uses detect_leaks=1. Other suites use their established detect_leaks=0 setting; this is not a whole-program leak result.

precision_extension.reason: Fixed precision extension after equivocal 0.012%/0.22% medians; no source changes, sample exclusions, or threshold changes.

retained_failures_and_experiments: The d542efb public launch-plan alias changed wildcard/snapshot behavior; aceef67 made it bundle-private. Original failed logs remain.
The aceef67 sanitizer session test found a poisoned tiny-slot free-list write. e7dfde5 unpoisons allocator metadata before recycling; the final full sanitizer run includes this fix.
Initial aceef67 snapshots encountered three root-owned temporary fixtures. Their ownership was repaired and both full profiles reran successfully; initial logs remain.
The e7dfde5 paired matrix missed the direct clean median gate by 0.24%; its 10,000-target conversion memory also regressed. Final queue and layout changes address these measurements.
The initial queue-lock consolidation did not improve its focused comparison and was reverted. Workers/batch-size experiments and raw samples remain.
An unprivileged sparse-groups build could not write existing root-owned object files. The build reran as root; final tests run as uid 1000.
limits: Real PC qualification for Linux 7.3, FFmpeg 9.0.2 and LibreOffice 26.8.2.2 has not run. No universal or real-project performance guarantee is claimed.
The strict acceptance cells require paired median candidate/baseline <=1.00 and bootstrap 95% upper <=1.05; thresholds were not relaxed.
wait4 RSS is peak individual-process RSS, not simultaneous aggregate process-tree memory. Small workloads can be masked by the Python parent/exec high-water floor.
tests/bench.py measures candidates in separate blocks. Its raw medians are retained alongside alternating paired controls; neither unpaired drift nor improvements in another cell cancel a regression.
Exploratory uncommitted binaries are not relabeled as final code. Every final acceptance run uses the recorded fd7573b binary and pinned toolchain.
